steps.title: Custom Serialization
steps.text: Learn to implement JSON, Protobuf, and custom serializers to convert complex objects for transmission over Surgewave topics.

steps.title: Headers and Metadata
steps.text: Attach metadata to messages without affecting the payload. Use correlation IDs for request tracking and trace context for distributed tracing.

steps.title: Error Handling Patterns
steps.text: Handle failures gracefully with retry policies, dead letter queues for unprocessable messages, and circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures.

steps.title: Transactions and Exactly-Once
steps.text: Ensure atomicity across multiple operations with transactions. Produce to multiple topics atomically and implement exactly-once processing guarantees.

steps.title: Compacted and Ephemeral Topics
steps.text: Use log compaction for changelog and config topics that keep only the latest value per key. Use ephemeral topics for real-time event distribution without persistence.
